rawFindings.title: Source map usage condition does not check for line number
rawFindings.explanation: The if statement at line 52 originally checked for both file.sourceMap and line being truthy to use source maps when formatting errors. The patch removes the check for 'line', so the code proceeds even if 'line' is falsy (e.g., 0 or undefined). This can lead to incorrect or unintended behavior since source maps require a valid line number to map positions.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check for 'line' to ensure source maps are only used when a valid line number is present: change 'if (file && file.sourceMap)' back to 'if (file && file.sourceMap && line)'. This prevents errors or misbehavior when line info is missing or invalid.
